batch_precedence: Source gate; global per-role duplicate/reference/anchoring checks; then for each structural Claim in lexical order validate both guards fully, then that Claim REF closure, before the next Claim; then per-Claim scope/source-parse/source-guard/source-REF/comparison in lexical order; final output bound. Earlier private intermediate findings never escape if a later Claim refuses.

caps.inherited: All frozen Body/source/binary/aggregate/record/work/output caps remain unchanged. No hidden deduplication, partial result, truncation or cap reset.

declaration_schema_entrypoint: Only a private fixed DeclarationSource entrypoint may be added to the existing pinned schema evaluator. Preserve complete bootstrap identity/inventory/acyclicity/work budgets. No caller-selected schema, root name, $ref, decoded source object or trusted boolean. Body entrypoint behavior remains unchanged.
entrypoint: check_claim_structure(body_raw: object, originals: object) -> own bounded status dict; originals is exactly the frozen source-component tuple interface.
explicit_omissions: No full dependency-DAG, claim-target/missing unrelated-source closure, unused-Dependency ownership, Task/Manifest/Reading/runtime pin or global cross-role ID closure. All remain binding before full replay; internal structure MATCH is not applicability or full replay acceptance.

No actual assessor eligibility, semantic role relevance, original source authentication/truth, currentness, authorization, semantic completeness, lattice law, benefit, external-human validation or native proof.
No implementation or tests run by this preparation. Owner adoption and independent review of exact contract/addendum/oracle pins required before code.
guard_algorithm_bound: Each guard at most32 nodes. Check all operands before reachability. Iterative descending-index propagation from last-node root reaches all backward operands within one32-node sweep; any unvisited node refuses. No recursion, interpretation, source-reference cycle evaluation or Boolean arithmetic.
null_policy: Every success/Claim entry field required. Only selector_id and source may be null: opaque profile only. A partial/empty/full single structural selector is still identified. No selector is designated for opaque profiles. ClaimKey always recomputed from complete canonical Claim, with no derived concatenation identity.
purpose: Internal exact five-field declaration structure comparison only. No natural-language extraction, Boolean evaluation, source truth, semantic relevance, completeness, applicability, current authority, assessor eligibility, accepted ReplayResult or product acceptance.

refusal_shape.error: exact first named code; no extra/null/partial-success fields
refusal_shape.stage: exact first stage above or unchanged source stage

reuse: First execute every frozen source-component check, exact error precedence and complete source-result output cap. Introduce only a private validated-source-bundle extraction so Body and original sources are parsed/verified once. Bundle contains newly owned validated Body, verified source alias/key/immutable bytes records, exact validated selector/quote/source resolution and source result. Public check_source_membership result/error contract must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Never accept a caller decoded Body/bundle/boolean as evidence. Existing source/schema bootstrap is inherited; no additional source-file/network/model access.
role_addendum: owner-design-addendum.json resolves relevant-role ambiguity only for this internal syntactic stage: primary source anchoring requires SOURCE role; exact REF target identity may use any of the five schema roles, while semantic_role_relevance remains UNPROVEN. This is not full-replay semantic relevance qualification or a guarantee deviation.
source_parse_boundary: Opaque sources stay opaque unless the Claim profile is Q_DECLARATION_IDENTITY_V1, exactly one selector covers the entire nonempty source and its source-membership is MATCH. Then and only then parse that source once per Claim as exact canonical DeclarationSource under pinned schema $defs/DeclarationSource. Full matching quote bounds this parse to4096 bytes. No prose reparsing, normalization, keyword extraction, Boolean simplification or fallback to opaque classification after a declared structural-source parse failure. Shared source bytes may be parsed again for another Claim (at most16 bounded parses); do not introduce cross-Claim eligibility caching. Every Claim independently needs its own Claim+source REF edge union. Body/source integrity parses still run once per invocation through the private bundle.

stage_order.rule: Entire existing source/blob/quote/range/membership/output-bound gate first; all source errors propagate unchanged. No claim result is evaluated on source refusal.

Require unique exact(Claim.id,Claim.revision) pairs (CLAIM_REVISION_DUPLICATE), then globally unique Dependency.id within that role (DEPENDENCY_ID_DUPLICATE). In lexical Claim id/revision order resolve every declared selector ID (CLAIM_SELECTOR_MISSING), then every dependency ID (CLAIM_DEPENDENCY_MISSING), then require each resolved Dependency.dependent equals that ClaimLabel (CLAIM_DEPENDENCY_OWNER). For each declared selector require a resolved owning-Claim SOURCE-role SOURCE-target Dependency with the identical complete selector SourceKey (CLAIM_PRIMARY_DEPENDENCY_MISSING). Finally every supplied Selector must have at least one declared Claim owner (CLAIM_SELECTOR_UNOWNED). Multiple Claims may share a selector but each needs its own valid source anchoring. Unused Dependency records and unrelated claim-target closure remain deferred explicitly.

Within each structural Claim in lexical order, condition then exception: require root==len(nodes)-1 (CLAIM_GUARD_ROOT), every NOT/AND/OR operand strictly earlier than its node (CLAIM_GUARD_ORDER), and every node reachable from root through node operands (CLAIM_GUARD_UNREACHABLE). Check root first, then all nodes in array order, then reachability. SourceKey REF is a leaf, not a node index or evaluated proposition. Body schema already checks exact node shapes, operand integer types and local bounds. No inference from TRUE/FALSE/REF labels. After both guards are valid, run that Claim REF stage before advancing to the next Claim. Therefore ClaimA missing REF beats a later ClaimB bad root.

After each Claim's complete guard graph validation, traverse condition then exception nodes in array order. Every REF SourceKey must have at least one resolved owning-Claim Dependency whose requires.kind=SOURCE and complete requires.source is identical; any schema role is accepted as a declared identity edge (CLAIM_REF_DEPENDENCY_MISSING). Then target key must exist among already verified source copies (CLAIM_REF_SOURCE_MISSING). No fabricated dependency or prose inference. Claim REF checks run even when later scope/quotation/structure comparison is unresolved or differs.

After all Claim guard/REF checks, process Claims in lexical order. OPAQUE_PROSE_V1 =>UNRESOLVED_UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE, no source parse and no designated selector in output. For structural profile: selector count other than exactly one =>CLAIM_SELECTOR_CARDINALITY refusal (both zero and more than one), never choose or invent a selector; exactly one selector not covering [0,source.bytes) or over an empty source =>UNRESOLVED_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE. Scope is checked before the matching-quote requirement. Full nonempty scope with selector DIFFERS =>NOT_CHECKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE. Full nonempty scope and MATCH continues. EMPTY_SOURCE_MATCH_NONPROBATIVE cannot qualify a declaration.

Parse the selected original once for this Claim with existing bounded canonical metadata rules: strict scalar UTF8/no BOM/duplicate keys, unsigned integer spelling,20digit/depth12/work caps and exact canonical bytes. Resource errors =>DECLARATION_RESOURCE; syntax/encoding/canonical failures =>DECLARATION_CANONICAL_JSON. Then validate complete object against pinned local $defs/DeclarationSource, with no new schema service or network refs; any missing/extra field, wrong schema/version, type, enum, bound or node shape =>DECLARATION_SCHEMA. Never classify invalid structured input as false or silently opaque.

For source condition then exception apply identical root-last, earlier-node and full-reachability laws; exact codes DECLARATION_GUARD_ROOT, DECLARATION_GUARD_ORDER, DECLARATION_GUARD_UNREACHABLE. No check is skipped because source/Claim statements differ.

For every source REF in condition then exception node order require an owning-Claim exact SOURCE-target Dependency under any schema role (DECLARATION_REF_DEPENDENCY_MISSING), then a supplied verified exact SourceKey (DECLARATION_REF_SOURCE_MISSING). The required edges are the union of both Claim and parsed source REF targets. Structure mismatch cannot conceal an omitted definition.

After both complete source and Claim schema/guard/reference checks, compare exactly subject,action,modality,condition,exception as complete closed structures. Object key ordering is canonical; node/operand array order is meaningful. Exact equality=>MATCHED_DECLARATION_STRUCTURE_ONLY; any difference=>DIFFERS_DECLARATION_STRUCTURE_ONLY. No theorem, equivalence, reorder, simplification, entailment or truth check.

Return only the complete own result, with canonical bytes plus one reserved process LF<=32768; overflow=>CLAIM_OUTPUT_BYTE_BOUND. No partial successes, raw source/statement copies, volatile fields or mutation of source/history. Existing public source gate/output cap remains binding independently.

success_shape.claims: lexical array of closed entries {claim:{claim_id,revision,sha256,bytes},profile,selector_id,source,source_membership,interpretation,semantic_role_relevance}. Claim sha256/bytes bind its complete canonical record, not authority. selector_id/source are explicit null when no designated selector. source_membership is NOT_SELECTED|MATCH|DIFFERS|EMPTY_SOURCE_MATCH_NONPROBATIVE. For a selected partial/empty/full selector retain its actual source component status. interpretation is one of the five successful dispositions defined above. semantic_role_relevance always UNPROVEN.
